# What’s The Latest Android Version? (2024)
[Android 14](https://www.android.com/android-14/) (Upside Down Cake) is the latest Android version, presenting many exciting features. Initially in a developer preview phase, it has since transitioned to a full public release in the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) as of October 4, 2023.
Currently, it's available on Google Pixel devices, the new Samsung Galaxy S24 smartphone range, and several other devices. More manufacturers are rolling out their custom versions, so it may reach your device sooner than you think.

...

## What's next for Google?
Android 15 is the next major update after the Upside Down Cake version. Tech Journalist [Mishaal Rahman](https://x.com/MishaalRahman/status/1631742485729878016?s=20) says that it will bear the codename “Vanilla Ice Cream,” although Google hasn't made an official statement or announced its release date.

...

But for the [Pixel 4a](https://www.talkandroid.com/429723-best-google-pixel-phone/) and other devices, Android 14 is the end of the road. You may check the official Android website or its social media channels to keep updated with OS news and release schedules.
